'''Mallow's mother''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM108|Memories in the Mist!]]''. She is the mother of {{an|Mallow}} and [[Ulu]], and the wife of [[Abe]]. Prior to ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'', she passed away due to an unspecified illness while Mallow was still little.

She first appeared in a flashback of her and Mallow going for a walk in a forest located behind the [[Pokémon School]]. During their walk, they encountered a {{TP|Mallow|Bounsweet}} that she {{pkmn2|caught}} and gave to Mallow for her to keep so that she wouldn't be lonely. She was also shown repeatedly apologizing to Mallow for her condition; this eventually frustrated Mallow and caused her to have an angry outburst towards her mother before leaving, which turned out to be their final conversation before her death.

She later appeared as an apparition created from {{DL|Guardian deities (anime)|Tapu Fini}}'s mist. She reunited and reconciled with her daughter as they exchanged their gratitude for each other.
